lead_editorial.title: Ramlila Maidan ki bheed ek sandesh hai, par voter list ka jhagda saboot aur sansthaon ke zariye hi sulajhega
lead_editorial.summary: INDIA bloc ki mahareli aur CEC ke khilaaf 'public impeachment' dikhaate hain ki SIR ko lekar vipaksh ka avishwas kitna gehra hai. Lekin aarop jitne bade hain, unki jaanch utni hi paardarshi aur saboot-aadhaarit honi chahiye — aur Chunav Aayog ko bhi sawaalon ka jawab khul kar dena hoga.
body: Aaj Delhi ke Ramlila Maidan mein 21 vipakshi dalon ka 'Chalo Dilli, Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' pradarshan aur ek din pehle Mallikarjun Kharge ke ghar par hua pratikaatmak 'public impeachment' — dono ek hi baat kehte hain: vipaksh ko Chunav Aayog ki Special Intensive Revision (SIR) par bharosa nahi raha. Congress ne 13 crore naam kaatne jaisa bada aarop lagaaya hai. Yeh aarop hai, saabit tathya nahi, aur isi farq ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai.

Loktantra mein shaantipurn pradarshan vipaksh ka adhikaar hai, aur sarkar ka kaam use izzat se jagah dena hai. Dhaara 163, das hazaar jawaan aur Jantar Mantar par paabandi suraksha ke naam par samajh mein aate hain, lekin trains-buses roke jaane jaise aaropon ka jawab bhi prashasan ko saaf-saaf dena chahiye. Utni hi zimmedaari vipaksh ki bhi hai ki 'deshdroh' aur 'jail' jaisi bhaasha nyaayik prakriya ki jagah na le le.

Asli sawaal Chunav Aayog se hai. Agar SIR mein naam hataaye ya jode gaye hain, to booth-star par aankde, aapattiyon ka nipataara aur appeal ki prakriya saarvajanik ho. Supreme Court mein Aayog ne kuch aaropon ko jaanch mein galat bataaya hai — achchha hoga ki wahi jaanch report janta ke saamne bhi aaye. Sanstha ki saakh bayaanon se nahi, paardarshita se banti hai.

Grih Mantri Amit Shah ne in aaropon par sansad ka vishesh satra bulaane ki baat kahi hai. Vipaksh ko yeh peshkash sweekaar karke apne saboot sadan mein rakhne chahiye, aur sarkar ko us bahas ko seemit karne ki koshish nahi karni chahiye. Sadak ka dabaav apni jagah, lekin voter list ka bharosa sansad, adaalat aur khule aankdon se hi lautega.

stories.title: INDIA bloc ka 'Chalo Dilli': Ramlila Maidan mein SIR aur CEC Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf 21 dalon ki mahareli; ek din pehle Kharge ke ghar hua pratikaatmak 'public impeachment'
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi, Kharge, Priyanka aur Akhilesh open buses mein Ramlila Maidan ke liye nikle. Delhi Police ke mutabik kareeb 10,000 police aur paramilitary jawaan tainaat hain, aur poori Delhi mein Dhaara 163 laagu hai.
body: Vipakshi INDIA bloc aaj Delhi ke Ramlila Maidan mein 'Chalo Dilli, Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' mahareli kar raha hai. The Tribune ke live blog ke mutabik 21 dalon ke neta — jinmein Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra aur Akhilesh Yadav shaamil hain — open buses mein Kharge ke ghar se Minto Road tak gaye, jahan se paidal Ajmeri Gate hote hue maidan pahunchne ka program hai. Vipaksh ki maang hai ki Chunav Aayog ki Special Intensive Revision (SIR) mein kathit gadbadiyon ki jawabdehi tay ho aur CEC Gyanesh Kumar istifa dein. Congress mahasachiv K.C. Venugopal ne daava kiya hai ki voter list se 13 crore naam kaate gaye — yeh unka aarop hai, jiski swatantra pushti nahi hui hai.

Isse ek din pehle, Shanivaar ko Kharge ke 10, Rajaji Marg wale ghar ke lawn par vipaksh ne CEC ka pratikaatmak 'public impeachment' kiya. ThePrint ki report ke mutabik iski adhyakshata purv Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar ne ki, Kharge ne prastaav rakha aur Rahul Gandhi ne ise 'political weapon' bataaya. Sabha ne prastaav paarit karke CEC par vote kaatne ka aarop lagaaya aur un par deshdroh ka mukadma chalaane ki maang ki. Yeh karyakram puri tarah pratikaatmak tha aur iska koi kanooni ya sanvaidhanik asar nahi hai.

Oneindia ki report ke mutabik suraksha ke liye kareeb 3,000 Delhi Police aur 7,000 paramilitary jawaan lagaaye gaye hain, saath hi drone, 250 AI-enabled CCTV camere aur 10 jagah traffic diversion. Vipaksh ne 10 lakh logon ke aane ka daava kiya, jabki police ne maidan ki kshamata ke hisaab se kareeb 50,000 ki taiyaari ki. BJP ne West Delhi mein jawaabi march rakha hai; Grih Mantri Amit Shah ne 'vote chori' ke aaropon par sansad ka vishesh satra bulaane ki peshkash ki thi. Congress ke Pawan Khera ne Telangana mein trains radd karne aur buses rokne ka aarop lagaaya, jise BJP ne khaarij kiya.

stories.title: Ekta Diwas par PM Modi: 'Naxalwaad khatm karne ka vaada poora hua', ab 'Dimagi Naxals' se saavdhaan rehne ki apeel; vipaksh par 'kartavya chhodne' ka aarop
stories.summary: Sardar Patel ki 151vi jayanti par Ekta Nagar mein PM ne kaha ki hathiyaarband Naxalwaad khatm ho gaya hai, lekin social media par afwaah failaakar ashaanti failaane waalon se desh ko satark rehna hoga.
body: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Shanivaar ko Gujarat ke Ekta Nagar mein Rashtriya Ekta Diwas samaaroh mein kaha ki pichhle saal unhone desh ko Naxalwaad aur Maowaad se mukt karaane tak kaam karne ka jo vaada kiya tha, woh poora ho gaya hai. The Week ki report ke mutabik PM ne saath hi chetaaya ki Naxal bhale khatm ho gaye hon, lekin 'Dimagi Naxals' desh mein ashaanti failaane ki koshish kar rahe hain.

PM ne vipaksh par 'apna kartavya chhod dene' ka aarop lagaaya aur kaha ki das saal se zyada samay tak satta se door rehne ki kunthaa usse chala rahi hai. Unhone social media par afwaahon ke zariye Bharat ki chhavi bigaadne ki koshishon ka zikr kiya aur seemaon ki suraksha, ghuspaith rokne, 'demographic badlaav' aur secular civil code ki disha mein badhne ko apni praathmiktaayein bataaya.

Paschim Asia ke sangharsh aur tel ki badhti keemton ka hawaala dete hue PM ne daava kiya ki sarkar ne vaishvik urja sankat ka bojh naagrikon par nahi padne diya. Vipaksh ki taraf se is bhaashan par aupchaarik pratikriya report mein shaamil nahi thi; INDIA bloc aaj Delhi mein apni mahareli kar raha hai.

stories.title: 1 November se commercial LPG Rs 10 mehnga hokar Rs 2,820, ATF lagaataar chauthe mahine badha; gharelu cylinder Rs 942 par sthir
stories.summary: 19 kilo ka commercial cylinder doosre mahine lagaataar mehnga hua, jabki hawaai jahaaz ka eendhan Rs 1.37 prati litre badhkar Rs 138.50 par pahuncha. Petrol-diesel ke daam bhi nahi badle.
body: Sarkaari tel companiyon ne 1 November se 19 kilo ke commercial LPG cylinder ki keemat Rs 10 badhaakar Rs 2,820 kar di hai. PTI/Business Standard ki report ke mutabik yeh lagaataar doosra maasik izafa hai — 1 October ko Rs 62.50 aur 1 September ko Rs 9.50 badhe the, jabki July aur August mein keemat mein badi katautiyan hui thi. Commercial cylinder June mein Rs 3,113.50 ke record star par tha.

Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) Rs 1.37 prati litre mehnga hokar Rs 138.50 ho gaya hai. Yeh lagaataar chautha maasik izafa hai; 1 October ko hi isme Rs 16 ki badhotari hui thi. ATF airlines ki laagat ka bada hissa hota hai, isliye iska asar kiraayon par nazar rakhne layak hoga.

Raahat ki baat yeh hai ki 14.2 kilo ka gharelu cylinder Rs 942 par sthir hai, haalaanki March se June ke beech isme Rs 89 badhe the. May mein lagbhag Rs 7.50 prati litre mehnge hue petrol-diesel ke daam bhi is baar nahi badle.

editorial.title: Naxalwaad ke khilaaf jeet badi hai, par 'Dimagi Naxal' jaise lebal asahmati ki jagah na chheenein
body: Hathiyaarband Naxalwaad ka khaatma — agar yeh daava zameen par tika rehta hai — to dashakon ki ladaai mein suraksha balon aur rajyon ki badi kaamyaabi hai. PM ka is par garv karna swaabhaavik hai, aur afwaahon se satark rehne ki unki apeel bhi apni jagah sahi hai.

Lekin 'Dimagi Naxal' jaise vyaapak lebal ka khatra yeh hai ki kahin har aalochak, chhaatra sangathan ya vipakshi pradarshan isi khaane mein na daal diya jaaye. Jis din vipaksh Ramlila Maidan mein Chunav Aayog ke khilaaf sadak par hai, us din yeh farq aur zaroori ho jaata hai: hinsa ka samarthan aparaadh hai, sarkar ya sansthaon se asahmati loktantra ki saans.

Kanoon ko hinsa aur uske sahaayakon par sakhti se kaam karna chahiye, par saboot ke aadhaar par, naaron ke aadhaar par nahi. Bandook ke baad ki shaanti tab tikegi jab Bastar se lekar campus tak logon ko lage ki unki baat sunne ki jagah maujood hai.

stories.title: Hormuz: Araghchi bole — Qatar ke madhyasthon ke saath do din mein raasta kholne ki yojana, par shart US ki; Trump — baatcheet 'theek chal rahi', jaldi nahi
stories.summary: Iran ke videsh mantri ne US ke baatcheet ke prastaav ko 'sakaaraatmak kadam' bataaya. Udhar IRGC ne aur tankeron ke baaroodi surangon se takraane ka daava kiya aur Saudi Arabia ne Riyadh ke upar kai drone giraaye.
body: Iran ke videsh mantri Abbas Araghchi ne kaha hai ki Tehran ne Qatar ke madhyasthon ke saath milkar Strait of Hormuz ko do din ke andar kholne ki ek yojana taiyaar ki hai, lekin yeh tabhi laagu hogi jab America Iran ki sharten maane. Al Jazeera ke live blog ke mutabik Araghchi ne US ke baatcheet ke prastaav ko 'a positive step' kaha, aur ek Irani pratinidhimandal Qatar mein hai. Udhar US Raashtrapati Donald Trump ne kaha ki baatcheet 'theek chal rahi hai', lekin unhe deal ki 'utni jaldi nahi' hai.

Zameen par tanaav bana hua hai. Gulf News ki live coverage ke mutabik Iran ke Revolutionary Guard ne daava kiya ki Shukravaar ko chaar tanker baaroodi surangon se takraakar jal uthe, aur Shanivaar raat Iran ki navy ne Strait ke poorab mein ek aur tanker mein aag lagne ki baat kahi — in daavon ki swatantra pushti nahi hui hai. Saudi Arabia ne Riyadh aur doosre ilaakon ke upar kai drone maar giraaye; ek drone Houthis dwara chhoda gaya bataaya gaya. Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ne US ko naye hamlon ke khilaaf chetaaya, jabki US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ne kaha ki Trump ne nayi strikes par abhi faisla nahi kiya hai.

Bharat ke liye raahat ki khabar yeh rahi ki Arabian Gulf mein projectile se takraaye ek LNG carrier par savaar sabhi chhah Bhartiya naavik surakshit bataaye gaye. Axios ki report ke hawaale se Gulf News ne likha ki Israel ke PM Netanyahu US midterm chunaav ke baad Iran par sanyukt hamle ke liye Trump par dabaav bana rahe hain.

stories.title: Atlanta mein G20 videsh mantriyon ki baithak bina sanyukt communique ke khatm; Rubio ne jaari kiya chair's statement, Lavrov ki maujoodgi par group photo radd
stories.summary: Ukraine yuddh par matbhed sabse badi rukaavat bane. Chair's statement mein urja-khaadya suraksha, samudri raaston ki aazaadi aur critical minerals ko saajhi praathmikta bataaya gaya, lekin koi thos samjhauta nahi hua.
body: America ke Atlanta mein do din chali G20 videsh mantriyon ki baithak Shanivaar ko kai bade suraksha muddon par sahmati ke bina khatm ho gayi. Daily Pioneer ki report ke mutabik koi sanyukt communique jaari nahi hua; uski jagah mezbaan US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ne chair's statement jaari kiya, jismein urja aur khaadya suraksha, samudri aavaajaahi ki aazaadi, surakshit supply chain aur critical minerals tak pahunch ko saajhi praathmikta bataaya gaya.

Aakhri satra mein Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea, Black Sea aur South China Sea mein jahaazon ki aavaajaahi par charcha hui, lekin Russia-Ukraine yuddh par gehre matbhed bane rahe. European rajnayikon ne Russi videsh mantri Sergey Lavrov ki maujoodgi par aapatti jataayi, jiske baad Rubio ne paaramparik group photo radd kar di. Poland ke videsh mantri Radosław Sikorski ne kaha ki jab sangharsh mein shaamil desh mez par hon, to sahmati na banna hairaani ki baat nahi.

Baithak ke itar Rubio ne Bharat, Australia aur Japan ke videsh mantriyon se alag baatcheet ki. The Tribune ki ek alag report ke mutabik videsh mantri S. Jaishankar ne Atlanta mein Lavrov se bhi mulaqaat kar Ukraine aur Paschim Asia ki sthiti par charcha ki.

editorial.title: Hormuz ki 'do din waali yojana' ek mauka hai — use sharton ki zid mein gawaana mehnga padega
body: Mahinon ke tanaav ke baad pehli baar Tehran ki taraf se Hormuz kholne ki ek samay-seema waali yojana ki baat saamne aayi hai, aur US ka lehja bhi kuch naram hua dikh raha hai. Lekin isi hafte tankeron par hamle, Saudi aasmaan mein drone aur 'midterms ke baad strike' ki khabrein bataati hain ki yeh khidki kitni naazuk hai.

Bharat ke liye daav seedha hai: Brent kareeb $117 par hai, LPG aur ATF mehnge ho rahe hain, aur Khaadi mein hazaaron Bhartiya naavik khatre ke beech kaam kar rahe hain. G20 mein bhi 'freedom of navigation' par sabki sahmati thi — bas use laagu karne ka raasta nahi tha.

Qatar ki madhyasthata ko donon pakshon ko gambhirta se lena chahiye. Sharton ka saarvajanik elaan baad mein ho sakta hai; pehle jahaazon ki surakshit aavaajaahi aur crew ki suraksha par thos kadam. Jo bhi paksh is mauke ko apni gharelu raajneeti ke liye taalega, uski keemat poori duniya chukaayegi.

stories.title: October mein gross GST collection 22.9% uchhalkar Rs 2.31 lakh crore; import se aay 42% badhi, net revenue Rs 2.03 lakh crore
stories.summary: Vitt mantralay ke aankdon ke mutabik gharelu aay 15.8% aur import se aay 42.2% badhi. April-October ka kul gross collection 13.2% badhkar Rs 14.78 lakh crore raha.
body: October 2026 mein gross GST collection Rs 2,31,290 crore raha, jo October 2025 ke Rs 1,88,125 crore se 22.9% zyada hai. Business Today ki report ke mutabik gharelu lenden se aay 15.8% badhkar Rs 1,59,044 crore aur import se aay 42.2% badhkar Rs 72,246 crore rahi. Ghatakon mein CGST Rs 42,935 crore, SGST Rs 51,340 crore aur IGST Rs 1,37,015 crore raha.

Refund 6.5% badhkar Rs 27,934 crore rahe. Inhe ghataane ke baad net GST revenue 25.6% badhkar Rs 2,03,356 crore pahuncha. Chaalu vitt varsh mein April se October tak gross collection 13.2% badhkar Rs 14,77,569 crore aur net collection 12.6% badhkar Rs 12,69,486 crore raha.

stories.title: Bazaar ka agla hafta: Nifty-Sensex ki 2% ki hafte bhar ki badhat ke baad nazar PMI, US midterms aur $117 ke Brent par; October mein FII ne Rs 34,843 crore nikaale
stories.summary: Pichhle hafte smallcap index 4% chadha. Aakhri hafte mein FII Rs 13,213 crore ke net khareedaar rahe, jisse mahine ki bikwaali kuch kam hui.
body: Pichhle hafte Nifty 50 lagbhag 2% aur Sensex 1.83% chadhe. Outlook Money ke mutabik Shukravaar, 30 October ko Nifty 23,053.10 aur Sensex 74,459.53 par band hue. Broader market aur aage rahe — Nifty Midcap 100 mein 2.69% aur Smallcap 100 mein 4% ki badhat rahi.

NSDL ke aankdon ke mutabik videshi sansthaagat niveshak (FII) October mein Rs 34,843 crore ke net bikwaal rahe, haalaanki aakhri hafte mein unhone Rs 13,213.41 crore ki net khareedaari ki. US 10-saal ka Treasury yield pichhle hafte 5% se neeche aaya, jise Bhartiya bazaar ke liye sahaayak maana ja raha hai.

Is hafte ke ahem sanket: 1 November ko OPEC+ ki baithak, 2 November ko Bharat ka final manufacturing PMI aur 4 November ko services PMI, 3 November ko US midterm chunaav, aur 6 November ko US non-farm payrolls. Brent hafte ke ant mein kareeb $117 prati barrel par tha. Report ke mutabik midterms ke baad Iran par sambhaavit US-Israel strikes ki khabrein nikat bhavishya ka bada jokhim hain. (Yeh nivesh salaah nahi hai.)

editorial.title: GST ki chamak achchhi khabar hai, par ise mehngaai aur import bill ke aaine mein bhi dekhna hoga
body: Rs 2.31 lakh crore ka GST aur 22.9% ki badhat sarkaari khazaane ke liye raahat hai, khaaskar jab Paschim Asia sankat ke beech kharch ka dabaav bana hua hai. Gharelu aay mein 15.8% ki badhotari tyohaaron ki maang ka sanket bhi deti hai.

Lekin import se aay ka 42% uchhalna sirf 'mazboot arthvyavastha' ki kahaani nahi ho sakta. Jab Brent $117 par ho aur ATF-LPG har mahine mehnge ho rahe hon, to oonchi keemton par laga tax bhi collection badhaata hai. Yaani kuch hissa upbhoktaon aur udyogon ki jeb se aa raha hai.

Sarkar ke paas behtar aay hai, to use is gunjaaish ka istemaal un kshetron ko raahat dene mein karna chahiye jo urja sankat se sabse zyada prabhaavit hain — chhote udyog, transport aur airlines par nirbhar yaatri. Collection ka jashn tabhi poora hai jab uska fayda wapas arthvyavastha tak pahunche.

stories.title: Hamilton T20I: Ishan Kishan ke 32 gend par 61 aur Shreyas Iyer ki 22 gend mein fifty se India ne banaaye 191/8; Adam Milne ke 4 wicket, New Zealand ko 192 ka lakshya
stories.summary: Series ke paanchve aur aakhri T20I mein New Zealand ne toss jeetkar pehle gendbaazi chuni. 19 run par do wicket girne ke baad Kishan-Iyer ne 93 run jodkar pari sambhaali. Yeh khabar India ki pari ke ant tak ki hai; series India pehle hi 3-1 ki badhat ke saath jeet chuka hai.
body: Seddon Park, Hamilton mein khele ja rahe paanchve T20I mein New Zealand ke captain Mitchell Santner ne toss jeetkar gendbaazi chuni, aur Adam Milne ne shuruaat mein hi Abhishek Sharma (1) aur Sanju Samson (4) ko pavilion bhej diya. 3.1 over mein score 19/2 tha. ESPNcricinfo ke scorecard ke mutabik iske baad Ishan Kishan ne 28 gend par fifty poori ki aur 32 gend mein 5 chauke aur 5 chhakkon ke saath 61 run banaaye. Captain Shreyas Iyer ne sirf 22 gend mein fifty jadi aur 23 gend par 50 run (3 chauke, 4 chhakke) banaakar out hue. Dono ne teesre wicket ke liye 93 run jode.

Beech ke overs mein India ki raftaar thodi thami — 112/2 se score 133/5 ho gaya. Naman Dhir ne 23 gend par 33 aur Nitish Kumar Reddy ne 17 gend par 22 run jodkar team ko 20 over mein 191/8 tak pahunchaaya. Milne New Zealand ke sabse safal gendbaaz rahe, jinhone 4 over mein sirf 19 run dekar 4 wicket liye; Nathan Smith aur Blair Tickner ko 2-2 wicket mile.

India paanch match ki series pehle hi 3-1 se apne naam kar chuka hai; Eden Park mein chauthe match mein New Zealand ne 87 run se jeet darj ki thi. Ab New Zealand ko yeh aakhri muqabla jeetne ke liye 120 gend par 192 run chahiye. Match ka nateeja hamaare agle edition mein.

stories.title: AI boom par sawaal: FT ke mutabik OpenAI ne funding lakshya $30 billion se ghataakar $20 billion kiya; S&P ne Meta ka outlook 'negative' kiya
stories.summary: S&P ne negative cash flow aur anishchit capex ka hawaala diya, haalaanki Meta ki AA- rating barkaraar rakhi. Meta ne aakalan se asahmati jataayi.
body: Fortune ki report ke mutabik Financial Times ne sootron ke hawaale se likha hai ki OpenAI ne apne naye funding round ka lakshya $30 billion se ghataakar $20 billion kar diya hai, aur ummeed ki ja rahi valuation bhi $1.4 trillion se ghatkar $1.25 trillion ho gayi hai. Report ke mutabik Anthropic ke S-1 filing aur agle mahine prastaavit IPO ne bhi is round ki chamak feeki ki.

Udhar S&P Global ne Shukravaar der raat Meta Platforms ka outlook 'stable' se ghataakar 'negative' kar diya, lekin AA- rating barkaraar rakhi. S&P ne negative cash flow aur anishchit capital expenditure ka hawaala diya; uske anumaan mein Meta ka capex is saal $140 billion aur 2027 mein $225 billion ho sakta hai, aur free operating cash flow 2027 mein -$71 billion tak ja sakta hai. S&P ne kaha ki AI nivesh se kamaai ka samay 'unclear' hai. Meta ne is aakalan se asahmati jataayi.

Yeh khabrein us hafte aayi hain jab Alphabet ka share Q3 mein cash flow aur negative hone ke baad ek din mein kareeb 12% gira aur Nasdaq mein tech bikwaali tez rahi. Report ke mutabik usi hafte Meta ne $95 billion equity jutaane ki yojana aur Microsoft ne $25 billion ke bond ka elaan kiya.

image.alt: Menlo Park, California mein Meta Platforms ka mukhyalay

stories.title: Kal SRK ka janmdin: reports ke mutabik 'King' ka teaser 2 November ko; udhar 'Ramayana' ki worldwide advance booking Rs 44.11 crore pahunchi
stories.summary: Siddharth Anand ki 'King' 24 December ko release hogi. 5 November ko aa rahi 'Ramayana' ke liye Sacnilk ke mutabik Bharat mein kareeb 3.29 lakh tickets bik chuke hain.
body: Shah Rukh Khan kal, 2 November ko apna janmdin manaayenge, aur Bollywood Hungama ki report ke hawaale se WION aur NewsBytes ne likha hai ki isi din unki film 'King' ka pehla teaser aa sakta hai. Siddharth Anand nirdeshit yeh action thriller Red Chillies Entertainment aur Marflix ki hai aur 24 December ko Christmas par cinemaghar mein aayegi. Film se Suhana Khan bade parde par debut kar rahi hain; cast mein Rani Mukerji, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone aur Anil Kapoor bhi hain. Teaser ki taarikh ki makers ki taraf se aupchaarik pushti in reports mein nahi hai.

Udhar Nitesh Tiwari ki 'Ramayana' 5 November ko release ho rahi hai. The Week ne trade portal Sacnilk ke hawaale se bataaya ki 31 October tak film ki worldwide advance booking Rs 44.11 crore pahunch gayi — Bharat mein Rs 19.61 crore gross (blocked seats hata kar Rs 16.31 crore) aur overseas Rs 24.50 crore. Desh mein kareeb 3.29 lakh tickets bik chuke hain, aur Karnataka, Maharashtra aur Delhi sabse aage hain.

Report ke mutabik Bhartiya multiplexes ke saath sharton ka masla haal hi mein suljha hai, jisse release se pehle ke aakhri dinon mein booking ke raftaar pakadne ki ummeed hai. Bharat mein Hindi version ka hissa 83% hai.

image.alt: Abhineta Shah Rukh Khan, 2023 ki file photo

editorial.title: AI ki daud mein ab paise ka hisaab bhi daudne laga hai — aur yeh sehatmand sanket hai
body: OpenAI ka chhota funding lakshya, Meta par S&P ki chetaavni aur Alphabet ki record giraavat — teenon ek hi baat kehte hain: niveshak ab sirf AI ke vaade nahi, uski kamaai ka samay bhi poochh rahe hain.

Yeh bubble phootne ka elaan nahi hai; in companiyon ke paas ab bhi bade sansaadhan hain. Lekin jab ek AA- rated company ka free cash flow dasiyon billion dollar negative rehne ka anumaan ho, to sawaal uthna laazmi hai ki itna bada kharch kitne saal mein laut kar aayega.

Bharat ke IT aur startup jagat ke liye sabak saaf hai: AI ko apnaane mein tezi ho, par business model aur grahak ki asli zaroorat ke saath. Hype ke daur mein bhi kitaab ka hisaab sahi rakhne waale hi lambi race jeette hain.
